# authn — LLM doc index (pinned: 0.26.0)
# One line per file; regenerate the pin on release. Read files at the tag that matches
# the running build (chart version == image tag == the repo tag; no v prefix).
docs/index.md: the map — what authn is + links to the bundle and the internals corpus
docs/overview.md: what it does and how it works — five login strategies, CSR-minted identity, platform peers
docs/usage.md: install via the Krateo installer pin or direct helm install oci://…; JWT-secret + RBAC dependencies
docs/configuration.md: the whole config surface — values, env ConfigMap contract, flags, OTel gates
docs/api.md: the five *.authn.krateo.io CRDs + the HTTP surface and login response contract
docs/rbac.md: how the minted client cert (CN=username, O=groups) binds to Kubernetes RBAC — RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding with User/Group subjects; authn issues identity, never authors RBAC
docs/jwt-jwks.md: RS256 signing + the JWKS endpoint (/.well-known/jwks.json) — key config, rotation, and how Snowplow/agentgateway consume it
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples
docs/release.md: how a release ships — one plain-semver tag drives image + charts
docs/log.md: curated history
examples/basic-user/README.md: User CR + password Secret enabling the basic strategy; curl login
examples/basic-user/manifest.yaml: the manifest — kubectl apply -f
examples/serviceaccount-mapping/README.md: ServiceAccount allowlist mapping for intra-service auth (projected SA token exchange)
examples/serviceaccount-mapping/manifest.yaml: the manifest — kubectl apply -f
# Internals corpus (code-traced to file:line under go/authn/ at this tag; authoritative for internals):
docs/architecture.md: how the service is built — main.go boot, route table, Route interface, kubeconfig generator, auth packages
docs/behavior.md: the served endpoints, the five CRDs it reads, per-strategy validation, integration contracts
docs/gotchas.md: real runtime pitfalls — RBAC traps, exact-match routing, OIDC token handling, snowplow URL quirk
docs/design/kubernetes-intra-service-auth.md: decision record (status: implemented, 0.23.0) — SA token → TokenReview → allowlist → JWT/clientconfig
# Source of truth beyond the docs:
go/authn/main.go: server wiring — flags/env, route registration, telemetry, CORS, graceful shutdown
go/authn/apis/: the Go types behind the five CRDs (User, ServiceAccount, LDAPConfig, OAuthConfig, OIDCConfig)
go/authn/crds/: the generated CRD manifests this repo owns (drift-gated in CI)
go/authn/internal/routes/: the Route interface and every endpoint handler
go/authn/testdata/: developer fixtures for every strategy (placeholder endpoints/credentials)
helm/authn/values.yaml: the chart's whole value surface (typed by values.schema.json)
